question_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), compare the crowd activity at DemoBooth_NVIDIA versus DemoBooth_Intel. Which booth was busier, and approximately what was the ratio of their average head_counts?
answer_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), DemoBooth_NVIDIA was busier than DemoBooth_Intel. The average headcount at DemoBooth_NVIDIA was 15.515, whereas DemoBooth_Intel had an average headcount of 10.648. The ratio of the average headcounts was approximately 0.69, indicating that DemoBooth_Intel had about 69% of the crowd activity of DemoBooth_NVIDIA.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'})
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA' AS location, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_head_count
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'DemoBooth_Intel'})
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN 'DemoBooth_Intel' AS location, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_head_count
}
WITH collect({location: location, avg_head_count: avg_head_count}) AS results
WITH results, 
     apoc.coll.sortMaps(results, 'avg_head_count') AS sorted_results
RETURN sorted_results[1].location AS busier_location, 
       sorted_results[1].avg_head_count AS busier_avg_head_count, 
       sorted_results[0].location AS less_busy_location, 
       sorted_results[0].avg_head_count AS less_busy_avg_head_count, 
       CASE WHEN sorted_results[0].avg_head_count > 0 
            THEN sorted_results[1].avg_head_count / sorted_results[0].avg_head_count 
            ELSE NULL 
       END AS ratio
